Class AbstractFileRepository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>>

java.lang.Object
SocialNetwork.repository.memory.InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
SocialNetwork.repository.file.AbstractFileRepository<ID,E>
Type Parameters:
ID - the type of the entity identifier
E - the type of the managed entity, extending Entity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<ID,E>
Direct Known Subclasses:
FriendshipFileRepository, UtilizatorFileRepository
public abstract class AbstractFileRepository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>> extends InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
Abstract base class for persisting entities to a text file using Java 8 Stream API and NIO.2. Extends InMemoryRepository by adding loading from file via Files.lines(Path) and automatic saving upon modifications via Files.write(Path, Iterable, java.nio.file.OpenOption...).
